name: koya_lump
desc: Make the puddle heave up into a big, heavy, crouching mound of the same thick glossy brown paint with cream swirls, rising from the middle of the puddle, like a huge body hunched forward and starting to get up: a broad rounded back and the shapes of two big shoulders bulge under a thick sagging layer of paint, the head is still buried inside the mound, thick heavy drips and sticky strands sag down into the puddle. About half as tall as a person. No face, no eyes, no arms or legs yet. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
